findings.title: Zero MaxSize dimension may constrain layout
findings.message: In the vertical toolbar, style.MaxSize is overwritten to Width 72 Height 154 after the narrow cap, which discards the narrow setting; additionally in the horizontal case MaxSize for the toolbar sets Height 0 which may be interpreted as an explicit zero limit rather than unset, depending on ui.Size semantics.
findings.suggestion: Verify that a zero Width/Height in MaxSize means unconstrained; otherwise avoid specifying it.

findings.title: Mixed toolbar overrides ignore display mode
findings.message: Toolbars page always reuses the same node IDs for the same sizes regardless of narrow state, but more importantly the 'toolbar-mixed' bar and the 'toolbar-vertical' bar both contain IDs like "toolbar-mixed/Delete" and separator IDs; the separator ID is id+"/separator" which is unique per bar, so fine. However, the action Activate closure for "Delete" and disabled state are hardcoded by name, so a user-visible Delete is never activatable and the mixed-bar override replaces nodes by index while ignoring m.display, so the display switch is silently ignored for mixed bar. Low impact.
findings.suggestion: Keep as is if intended; otherwise document.
